@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'Elicitation task 45: a run sends the questions of its child session to its parent (SubagentQuestionRelay)'
+---
+Adopt Router e2688ac2 and Extras 11b7c7e. The design is in Router card 01M51Y3XRHGPH5813J4WKNSJVQ, section 5.
+
+1. `StartAgent.execute` stores `SubagentQuestionTarget.current` in `AgentRunRequest`, next to `context`.
+2. `AgentSessionMaker.makeSession` sets `userPresence: request.questionTarget?.userPresence ?? .headless`. A run session is no longer always headless.
+3. `AgentRun.drive` starts the relay before `mailTaskPrompt`, with `agentName: definition.id`. After `session.close()` and `await following`, it calls `await relay.finish()`. Then it drops the target, because the target holds a strong reference to the parent.
+4. `follow` calls `answerQuestion` only when the run has no target.
+5. The idle checks (`acceptedMessagesIfIdle`, `endStateIfDrained`) also require `await session.openElicitationIds()` to be empty. `elicitationEnded` and `elicitationCompleted` cause an idle check.
+
+A cancel of the run closes the child session (the drive does this already). Write fixed-order tests that fail first. Do not use a time limit, a sleep, a poll or a retry. Do one full run. Do not push before the peer tells that the Router CI of e2688ac2 is green. #elicitation-phase-4
\ No newline at end of file
